45091.name: York County
45091.note: York County franchises 911 response to these three; Piedmont described as primary countywide. Atrium Health was buying Fort Mill EMS (council decision pending as of 2025-03; outcome not found), so the Fort Mill operator may now be Atrium. County site (yorkcountysc.gov) 403s; county About-Us page lists Piedmont EMS, Atrium Health Fort Mill EMS and River Hills/Lake Wylie EMS (per search snippet, not fetched).
